profile.address: 1000 San Leandro Blvd., Suite 300, San Leandro, CA 94577
profile.summary: The Alameda County Public Health Department is the county government agency responsible for community and population health. It works to prevent disease, monitor the health of residents, run outreach and health promotion, and address causes of health inequity. Its services include immunization programs.

sources.title: Alameda County holds free vaccination clinic for students, school staff Wednesday

review.notes: The county Public Health Department page confirms the summary, website, phone and address, and the agenda item (COVID-19 vaccine administration on District facilities) matches the department's vaccination clinics at the OUSD Student Welcome Center. The summary is neutral and the press email was rightly omitted.
